nodes.name: Platform Operator
nodes.description: Person migrating an existing BIND9 server into bindy. Runs forage on a host that can read the BIND9 configuration, reviews the output, and applies it with kubectl under their own Kubernetes credentials.

nodes.name: BIND9 Host Filesystem
nodes.description: The existing (non-Kubernetes) BIND9 server's configuration tree, or a copy of it. forage only reads it; it never connects to named or to rndc (ADR-0001).

nodes.name: named.conf
nodes.description: BIND9 configuration (and its include files). Supplies zone names, zone types and zone-file paths.

nodes.name: Zone Files
nodes.description: RFC 1035 master files referenced by primary zones. Supplies the SOA, NS glue and the A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV and CAA records forage maps.

nodes.name: forage CLI
nodes.description: Stateless, one-shot Rust binary (ADR-0001) with no third-party crates (ADR-0006). Reads named.conf and zone files, maps them to bindy CRD manifests, prints them to stdout and exits. Holds no credentials, opens no network connections and keeps no state between runs.

nodes.name: named.conf / Zone-File Parsers
nodes.description: src/named_conf.rs and src/zone_file.rs: forage's own parsers for exactly the constructs it maps (ADR-0006). named.conf is read as a generic statement tree from which zone, options and include statements are taken; zone files follow RFC 1035 master-file rules. Lines that do not parse are reported, never silently dropped.

nodes.name: Mapper
nodes.description: src/mapper.rs: turns the parsed AST into DNSZone and record manifests using the hand-written wire-format structs in src/crd.rs (ADR-0002), rendered by forage's own JSON and YAML writers (src/json.rs, src/yaml.rs). Collapses multi-address A/AAAA sets; folds SOA and NS into the DNSZone.

nodes.name: Manifest Stream (stdout)
nodes.description: YAML (or JSON) stream of bindy CRs: DNSZone first, then record CRs, all labelled bindy.firestoned.io/managed-by=forage. The only output forage produces; diagnostics go to stderr.

nodes.name: kubectl
nodes.description: The operator's own Kubernetes client. forage does not apply anything itself; the operator pipes or reviews the stream and applies it with their own RBAC.

nodes.name: Kubernetes API Server
nodes.description: Target cluster control plane. Admission validates every manifest against the bindy CRD OpenAPI schema and CEL rules before it is stored.

nodes.name: bindy CRDs
nodes.description: DNSZone, ARecord, AAAARecord, CNAMERecord, MXRecord, TXTRecord, SRVRecord and CAARecord (bindy.firestoned.io/v1beta1). The contract forage's output must satisfy; verified in CI against a pinned bindy release (ADR-0003).

nodes.name: bindy Operator
nodes.description: Reconciles the imported CRs into BIND9 instances. Outside forage's scope; listed because it is the consumer the manifests are written for.

relationships.description: forage is one binary: its own parsers and the mapper, no third-party crates
The BIND9 host holds the configuration and zone files
The operator runs forage, reviews its output and applies it
reads named.conf and includes (local file I/O, read-only)
reads zone files resolved from the file option (local file I/O, read-only)
create/patch bindy CRs with the operator's credentials
admission validates every manifest against the CRD schema
hand-written structs mirror the CRD wire format (ADR-0002)
watches and reconciles the imported CRs
